purpose: Define the fail-closed restart path for bidirectional pawn-task transfer and predictive policy ranking after the follower-elbow external service boundary is cleared.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Inspect, service, or replace the follower elbow ID-3 STS3215 actuator or gear train and document the mechanical result.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: No unexplained inward mechanical resistance remains; the arm is torque off before and after inspection.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Run a new configuration-free identity and torque-off telemetry inventory.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: Robot identity, calibration, joint limits, cable freedom, cameras, gateway state, and emergency-stop path are reverified without motion.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Prospectively freeze a bounded no-contact elbow tracking qualification.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: The formerly stalled inward corridor completes within tracking, stall, slew, collision, exclusion, and controlled-return gates.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Acquire and approve the minimum gauge-fixed task mapping.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: Board, floor/support plane, robot base, articulated links, jaws, and camera projections pass untouched mapping gates; global mapping approval becomes evaluator-owned.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Record new exact source episodes with contact and object observability.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: At least two fit and one untouched validation episode bind requested, sent, measured, timestamps, metric jaw/object paths, per-sample contact state, outcome, and exact hashes.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Identify one contact/object mechanism at a time and validate it on untouched episodes.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: No sealed-task tuning, endpoint injection, observed-mode latch, action repair, or unidentifiable posterior is admitted.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Prospectively freeze bidirectional physical task packets.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: At least two feasible action families per direction survive static geometry, collision, camera, gateway, baseline-plant, and temporal-challenger gates before any counted task attempt.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Execute separately preregistered REAL-to-SIM and distinct SIM-to-REAL attempts.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: Exact numerators and denominators, action/evaluator/config hashes, object/contact traces, first divergence, torque-off cleanup, and untouched heldouts are recorded; no direction borrows the other's task outcome.

restart_preconditions_in_order.requirement: Run the bounded predictive policy-ranking pilot after the first bidirectional proof.
restart_preconditions_in_order.acceptance: At least three prospectively declared controller or checkpoint identities, a frozen ID/OOD distribution, a frozen physical sampling schedule, rank metrics, outcome metrics, failure-map uncertainty, and exact attempt denominators are reported.

packet_state.reason: Follower-elbow service, no-contact tracking qualification, and global mapping approval are unresolved.
